Name: SteamExe
Description: path to steam.exe, for games that must be launched through steam. use together with AppId.

Name: AppId
Description: the steam appid to launch. only used together with SteamExe.

Name: Console
Description: how console commands reach the game: exec (default) relaunches it with -hijack, rcon talks to it over the network, auto picks by what the game supports.
Warning: a game that cannot be hijacked needs rcon or auto.
